tickets.title: Open and Prepare New Account
tickets.text: Prepare and submit the opening package for a new joint taxable advisory account for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz with transfer-on-death registration, moderate-growth objective, and no Paper Otter Analytics concentration, to hold cash above the $120,000 reserve target and anticipated estate proceeds.

subTasks.title: Confirm account profile and registration
subTasks.text: Verify the intended joint account type, transfer-on-death registration, moderate-growth objective, tax sensitivity, and exclusion of Paper Otter Analytics concentration for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review account documents
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian forms for the new joint taxable advisory account for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz, ensuring the profile reflects moderate-growth objective and tax sensitivity.

subTasks.title: Submit opening package and track approval
subTasks.text: Submit the account opening package for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz's new joint taxable advisory account and monitor for approval.

subTasks.title: Confirm funding and first operational setup
subTasks.text: Confirm funding instructions for the new joint taxable advisory account for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz to hold cash above the $120,000 reserve target and anticipated estate proceeds.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to proceed with the account-opening work by 2024-11-01.

tickets.title: Collect Benefits Enrollment Information
tickets.text: Perform a side-by-side review of medical coverage, disability options, life insurance, HSA/FSA eligibility, and retirement plan contributions for Lila Pebblefizz's new role at Moonbadger Design Studio using the provided portal screenshots.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete the Moonbadger Design Studio benefits enrollment review by 2024-10-25.

tickets.title: Complete Year-End Tax Projection and Charitable Analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a projection coordinating withholding, estimated tax exposure, appreciated-share giving, and charitable gift timing for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz to inform year-end funding decisions.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete the year-end tax projection and charitable funding analysis by 2024-12-06.

tickets.title: Gather Inheritance Intake Details
tickets.text: Collect core facts regarding the $220,000 cash and fractional inherited IRA interest from Adele Pebblefizz's estate, including estate contact information, beneficiary status, and expected distribution schedule.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to complete the inheritance intake for Adele Pebblefizz’s estate by 2024-10-30.

tickets.title: Reconcile Paper Otter Analytics Stock Cost Basis
tickets.text: Reconcile the discrepancy between Nolan Pebblefizz's spreadsheet cost basis and the Velvet Acorn Custody unrealized gain report for Paper Otter Analytics tax lots to determine suitable shares for gifting or trimming.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the Paper Otter Analytics stock basis by 2024-11-08.

tickets.title: Address Velvet Acorn Custody Portal Settings
tickets.text: Confirm current records and correct account-level settings for the Velvet Acorn Custody portal regarding paper delivery and the missing beneficiary update for Nolan Pebblefizz's IRA.
tickets.evidence: The service follow-up is limited to confirming current records and correcting account-level settings where needed, and they agreed to address it by 2024-10-23.

tickets.title: Prepare Estate Document Coordination Points
tickets.text: Prepare coordination points to send to the estate attorney regarding outdated guardianship provisions and the successor trustee who has moved overseas for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz's estate plan.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare the estate document coordination points by 2024-11-15.
